subject: I-O status
notes: §9.1.13.7 3) '43' when the last I-O statement before a sequential-access DELETE RECORD/REWRITE was not a successful READ (cite.py --check OK §9.1.13.7 3)). The gate is PrevOpWasSuccessfulRead: it is dropped in the one Status setter (every statement outcome) and re-armed only by ReadSucceeded, so any intervening statement - UNLOCK, a failed OPEN '41', DELETE FILE, a failed REWRITE - clears it. Keyed connectors apply it only when Access == Sequential (the rule's 'in the sequential access mode'); a sequential-organization file is always sequential access.
